texts.zh:
为了提升我们研究新技术的速度，请在拥有£physics£物理，£society£社会或£engineering£工程资源的行星上建立£science_ship£研究站。

研究站的工作方式和£mining_station£开采站类似，其区别在于收集的资源不一样。研究站无法收集£strategic_resource£战略资源和£minerals£矿物。

要建造研究站，需要选择一艘£construction_ship£工程船，并在舰队界面选择[GetBuildGrowCap]研究站的按钮，然后点击含有拥有物理、社会或工程资源的£planet£行星、小行星或恒星之上。
texts.en:
To improve the rate at which we research new technologies, £science_ship£ Research Stations should be built above any world that possesses £physics£ Physics, £society£ Society or £engineering£ Engineering resources.

Research Stations function much in the same way as £mining_station£ Mining Stations - their sole difference is in the resources they collect. They are not capable of mining £minerals£ Minerals or £strategic_resource£ Strategic Resources.

To build one, select your £construction_ship£ Construction Ship and click on the [GetBuildGrowCap] Research Station button in its fleet interface. Then click on an available £planet£ Planet, asteroid or sun that has a deposit of Physics, Society or Engineering resources.
